fields.name: service_date
fields.description: Service date. References GTFS

fields.name: trip_id_performed
fields.description: Uniquely identifies the trip performed. It must be unique for a service_date (and it can optionally be unique across all time). It does not have to equal trip_id_scheduled.

fields.name: vehicle_id
fields.title: ID referencing vehicles.vehicle_id
fields.description: Identifies the vehicle.

fields.name: trip_id_scheduled
fields.title: ID referencing GTFS trips.trip_id
fields.description: Identifies the scheduled trip associated with the trip performed. One scheduled trip may be associated with multiple operated trips, or an operated trip may not be associated with a scheduled trip. References GTFS.  If this trip was published in GTFS Schedule, this value should be consistent with the GTFS `trip_id`.  If this trip was not scheduled, the value should be Null.

fields.name: route_id
fields.title: ID referencing GTFS routes.route_id
fields.description: Identifies the route. References GTFS

fields.name: route_type
fields.description: Indicates the type of transportation used on a route. References GTFS routes.route_type including Google's [Extended Route Types](https://developers.google.com/transit/gtfs/reference/extended-route-types) GTFS extension

fields.name: ntd_mode
fields.description: NTD mode, as the two-character mode code defined in the Modes and Types of Service section of the NTD Full Reporting Policy Manual <https://www.transit.dot.gov/ntd/manuals> (for example MB for Bus, CR for Commuter Rail). Leave empty for trips with no NTD mode.

fields.name: route_type_agency
fields.description: Agency specific route type

fields.name: shape_id
fields.title: ID referencing shapes.shape_id
fields.description: Identifies a geospatial shape that describes the vehicle travel path for a trip. References GTFS

fields.name: pattern_id
fields.title: unique identifier for the route-pattern
fields.description: Identifies the unique stop-path for a trip, may be distinct from GTFS shapes.shape_id

fields.name: direction_id
fields.description: Indicates the direction of travel for a trip. References GTFS

fields.name: operator_id
fields.title: ID referencing crew.crew_id
fields.description: Identifies the vehicle's operator. Optional; for trips with multiple operators, use the first operator or reference the vehicle_crew table for complete crew assignments.

fields.name: block_id
fields.title: ID referencing trips.block_id
fields.description: Identifies the block to which the trip belongs. A block consists of a single trip, or many sequential trips made using the same vehicle, defined by shared service days and block_id. A block_id can have trips with different service days, making distinct blocks. See example in GTFS documentation. References GTFS

fields.name: trip_start_stop_id
fields.title: ID referencing GTFS stops.stop_id
fields.description: Origin stop_id. References GTFS

fields.name: trip_end_stop_id
fields.title: ID referencing GTFS stops.stop_id
fields.description: Destination stop_id. References GTFS

fields.name: schedule_trip_start
fields.description: Scheduled departure time from the trip's origin.

fields.name: schedule_trip_end
fields.description: Scheduled end timestamp at the trip's destination.

fields.name: actual_trip_start
fields.description: Timestamp at which the vehicle departed its origin.

fields.name: actual_trip_end
fields.description: Timestamp at which the vehicle arrived at its destination.

fields.name: trip_type
fields.description: Indicates status of travel with regard to service.

fields.name: schedule_relationship
fields.description: Indicates the status of the trip. References GTFS-realtime TripUpdate.trip.schedule_relationship

name: trips_performed.schema.json
description: Trips performed for each service date.
